The READ TABLE + v2 + v3 procedure is consistent: exactly one row fires in all 96 enumerated cells, and no rule contradicts another. Six gaps leave a pair undefined or a rule ambiguous (K1 fails in row 4, C5 with K1, K2'' scope, poller scope for new files, twin Kaggle Error, B without twin), and the late-OK rule lives only in round5/report.json. findings.what: Consistency audit of READ TABLE (23:12) + CLARIFICATION v2 (01:20) + v3 (04:04) as one procedure. Every outcome gets exactly one row, because C1 (row 1 on K2 alone, rows 2-5 only when both are terminal) and first-match order hold, and d1 thresholds exhaust the k axis (row 3 d1 >= -0.001; rows 4/5 d1 <= -0.002, split by clean). The pair is well defined in 90 of 96 enumerated cells. Real gaps: G1 row 4 / row 5->4 when K1 is submitted but ERRORs, is not R5-admissible or scores < 0.953 (the text only says 'No K1'). G2 C5 (twin ERROR, not clean) with K1 scored: the pair is not stated. G5 V3 raises the K2'' question whenever L(K2)_hi > 8.0 h, including row 5->4 (lowrefine removed, yet K2'' contains lowrefine) and row 2 where K2 is not ticked; V3 also says 'replaces K2 as F1' although in row 2 K2 can only be F2. G6 V7 poller stop rule covers only #37/#38, not a K2 resubmit, K1 or K2''. G7 no path for a twin 'Kaggle Error'. G9 V4's B is undefined when the twin ERRORs. W1 the late-OK validity rule ('rows matched before the OK use the strict text') exists only in round5/report.json, not in CONTEXT. No direct contradiction found. Two counter-intuitive but consistent outcomes: (i) row 5 'kept' always puts F1 = K2 at <= 0.952, below #34's 0.953, by design; (ii) at k = w = 0.952 the clean flag flips the pair between {#34, exp52} (clean) and {#37, exp52} (not clean). Precedence also needs to be stated once: v3 > v2 > table > f2 > §f. f2 dropped §f's variant-F2 conditions (F1 >= 0.954, variant >= F1 - 0.001), so e.g. {K2 0.956, twin 0.953} is valid.

findings.what: READ TABLE CLARIFICATION v4 (gap fill only; no row or pair defined by the table, v2 or v3 changes; write only if no #37/#38 result is in poll.log yet, else record as post-hoc NOTES). W1 LATE OK: an [OK] item counts only if the user's OK message time (UTC) < the poll.log time of the first result it reads (K2 resubmit and row-1 K1: K2's result; floor, row 2 and C4: the later of K2 and twin). Otherwise the [bracketed] strict text decides; a later user override is logged as 'user decision after score', never as pre-registered. W2 K1 FAILS in row 4 or row 5->4: K1 ERROR, not R5-admissible or < 0.953 = 'No K1' -> pair {twin, exp52} if the twin is eligible, else {#34, exp52}. W3 C5 WITH K1: if K1 is submitted under C5 and is eligible, K1 replaces K2 only if K1 - K2 >= +0.002 (the §f simpler-file rule); F2 stays exp52. W4 K2'' SCOPE: the V3 runtime question goes to the user only when the resolved pair contains K2 (row 3, row 5 kept, C5, row 2 with F2 = K2). K2'' takes K2's place in the pair. Not in row 1, row 4, row 5->4, or row 2 without K2 (there lowrefine is removed or K2 is not ticked). W5 B WITHOUT TWIN: if the twin ERRORs, B = L(K2)_hi. W6 POLLER SCOPE: V7 covers every file the table submits (K2 resubmit to submit + 8.0 h, K1 to + 9.5 h, K2'' to + 10.5 h). Do not stop the poller until each is terminal and past its mark. W7 TWIN KAGGLE ERROR [OK]: a 'Kaggle Error' on the twin alone -> one unchanged resubmit of exp58n v1; without the OK F2 = exp52 by f2. W8 INFO: row 5 'kept' always has F1 = K2 with public <= 0.952 (below #34), by design (timing confound). Tell the user; W4 then offers K2''.

findings.what: POST-COMPETITION LESSONS (lab -> LB transfer): (1) TRANSFERRED: a separate division network inserting forks (DaughterNet): +0.001 twice, on different bases (exp47 0.947 -> exp48 0.948; #34 0.953 -> #35 0.954). This was the only post-ILP mechanism that moved the LB up more than once. | (2) TRANSFERRED: better detection geometry (the x138 V1284 coordinate-refinement head on our stack): exp48 0.948 -> exp51 0.950 (+0.002). Gains came from detection and localisation, not from the linker tail (round 3: 49% of FN edges are node misses and 43% are 'swaps' that are really localisation errors). | (3) DID NOT TRANSFER: anything that trusts the in-sample ILP or edge net more. Edge filter lab +0.016 -> LB 0.947/0.946 vs 0.947 (probes 29/30). The FD 'trust ILP over relink' pattern was +0.007 locally and is an artefact. Lab clips the edge net was trained on are not a validation set. | (4) DID NOT TRANSFER: small lab gains below ~+0.003 on 56-clip beds. floatout lab +0.0025 -> 0 twice (exp52 = exp51, exp53 = exp48). Leaf prune lab +0.0006/+0.0008 -> 0 twice (exp47 = exp39, P36 = #35). Relink tweaks (friend B +0.0053 on 12 videos) -> relink off, bonus 2.5 and gshift all 0.945. | (5) HURT: changing TTA views or model weights in a tuned stack. Z-flip TTA 0.941/0.938, axis-flip 0.946, primary swap 0.944, fine-tuned secondary 0.937, weight soup 0.943, all against a 0.947 base. Treat the public stack's model/TTA choice as frozen unless there is an honest OOF read. | (6) REPRODUCE FIRST: a public notebook run verbatim on our account can differ from the author's score (takaito 0.951 -> 0.944), while x138 reproduced exactly (0.953). Always spend one probe on a verbatim copy before building on it. | (7) RULES THAT WORKED: pre-registration before scores, plus sha-identity dummies (K1 dummy sha == exp57b; FF CSV == exp56), plus power clauses in lab gates. Five fork-removal riders were killed in the lab, and every LB read of that class agreed (probe 18 -0.001, P36 0). No post-hoc knob ladder was used. | (8) RUNTIME IS A FIRST-CLASS RISK: the only runtime evidence is latency from our own 10-min poller (plus failed-CLI padding). Build deadline guards (safetail) and fail-soft stages before stacking slower components. Our submissions run concurrently, so a paired twin is a runtime control. | (9) LEADERBOARD MECHANICS: 3-decimal display plus the unrounded order inside a block means late copies of a public notebook land at the bottom of its block (5 windows of x138 copies). Being in a score block early matters less than the unrounded score. Public is one embryo (~29%), so a +0.001 public step is real on that embryo but weak evidence for private. | (10) PROCESS: after the mechanism freeze, night research rounds produced rule clarifications, not score. Stop mechanism search earlier and put the remaining agent hours into the finals decision procedure and runtime proofs.
